'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Attacks on civilians in the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
****Russian forces [[shell (projectile)|shell]] residential buildings in [[Zaporizhzhia]], killing at least three people, injuring twelve others, and causing widespread fires. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/shelling-ukraines-zaporizhzhia-causes-fires-injuries-official-2022-10-06/ (Reuters)]
*[[War against the Islamic State]]
**[[American-led intervention in the Syrian civil war]]
***A [[United States Air Force]] [[airstrike]] and helicopter raid kill two senior [[Islamic State]] leaders in [[Qamishli]], [[Syria]], including the Islamic State's deputy leader in Syria. [[United States Central Command|CENTCOM]] says that no civilians nor any U.S. military personnel were killed or injured in the operation. [https://edition.cnn.com/2022/10/06/politics/us-isis-raid-syria/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Tigray War]]
**An [[airstrike]] kills at least five people and injures 37 others in [[Tigray Region]], [[Ethiopia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/air-strike-ethiopias-tigray-region-kills-least-5-people-doctor-2022-10-07/ (Reuters)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[2022 Nobel Prize in Literature]]
**French author [[Annie Ernaux]] is awarded the [[Nobel Prize in Literature]] for "the courage and clinical acuity with which she uncovers the roots, estrangements and collective restraints of personal memory". [https://www.reuters.com/lifestyle/french-author-annie-ernaux-wins-2022-nobel-prize-literature-2022-10-06/ (Reuters)]
*The [[Irish Dancing Commission]], [[Republic of Ireland|Ireland]]'s governing body for [[Irish dancing]], appoints a former judge to investigate claims of prominent dance schools and teachers [[Match fixing|fixing]] [[Competitive dance|competitions]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/oct/06/irish-dancing-world-cheating-allegations-clrg (''The Guardian'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2021–2022 inflation surge]]
**[[President of Belarus|Belarusian president]] [[Alexander Lukashenko]] bans price increases as part of an effort to reduce [[inflation]] in the country. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2022/10/06/belarus-leader-bans-price-rises-to-tackle-inflation-a79010 (''The Moscow Times'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[Hurricane Ian]]'s death toll increases to 130, with 125 deaths in the [[United States]] and five in [[Cuba]], making it the 24th deadliest [[hurricane]] in [[US history]]. [https://www.cnn.com/us/live-news/hurricane-ian-florida-aftermath-10-05-22#h_721e5345fb5446f2d50defe9da8992a9 (CNN)]
*At least 15 people are killed and 20 others are missing after a [[List of migrant vessel incidents on the Mediterranean Sea|boat carrying migrants sinks]] off the eastern coast of the [[Greek island]] of [[Lesbos]]. Five others have been rescued. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/world/15-migrants-dead-shipwreck-greek-island-lesbos-2990766 (CNA)]
*Sixteen people are killed and 20 others are injured when a bus overturns in [[Bara District]], [[Nepal]]. [http://english.news.cn/20221006/0c32184658a34ccb8578942c47058f92/c.html (Xinhua)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2022 monkeypox outbreak]]
**[[Mozambique]] reports its first case of [[monkeypox]]. [https://www.thestar.com.my/news/world/2022/10/07/mozambique-reports-first-case-of-monkeypox (''The Star'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[War on drugs]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]] announces that he will [[Federal pardons in the United States|pardon]] anyone who was convicted on prior federal charges, or who was convicted in the [[District of Columbia]], for [[Cannabis (drug)|marijuana]] possession. [https://www.cnbc.com/2022/10/06/biden-to-pardon-all-prior-federal-offenses-of-simple-marijuana-possession-.html (CNBC)]
*[[2022 Nong Bua Lamphu massacre]]
**At least 36 people, including 24 children, are killed and 10 others injured when a [[dismissal (employment)|dismissed]] [[Royal Thai Police|policeman]] [[mass shooting|open fire]] in a [[mass shooting]], which started at a [[daycare centre]] in [[Na Klang district]], [[Thailand]]. The perpetrator later commits [[suicide]] after killing his family at his home. [https://apnews.com/article/shootings-thailand-84efe7ba76707f4b3d47ee8394c4f24f (AP)]
*[[2022 Las Vegas Strip stabbings]]
**Two people are killed and six others are injured, three of them critically, in a [[mass stabbing]] on the [[Las Vegas Strip]] in [[Paradise, Nevada|Paradise]], [[Nevada]], [[United States]]. [https://www.ktnv.com/news/crime/suspect-arrested-after-stabbing-several-people-on-las-vegas-strip (KTNV-TV)]
*[[Iran]]'s [[Islamic Republic of Iran Broadcasting|IRIB]] broadcasts purported confessions from two French citizens accused of [[espionage]]. This broadcast comes in the context of the [[Mahsa Amini protests]] which began in September as well as the claim by the Iranian government that the protests are an attempt by [[France]] and other countries such as the [[United States]] and [[Israel]] to overthrow the current Iranian Islamic government. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/iran-airs-video-with-2-french-citizens-arrested-for-spying/2022/10/06/9113a222-4553-11ed-be17-89cbe6b8c0a5_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
